description: Fires right after the opponent drops a stone in column 0 (the left edge) that lands on row 3 or 4, i.e. the 4th or 5th stone in that column; 5th stone fires strongest. Tall columns 1 and 2 weaken it, and a 4th-stone drop late in the game usually does not fire. Other columns (including column 6), lower stones, the 6th stone, or a column-0 stack built a few moves earlier mostly do not fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 1-2 points.
notes: Hypotheses: last move col0 high (supported), any edge column (rejected: col 6 gives ~0), col0 height alone (rejected: activation decays within 1-3 moves). Dev F1: 0.719 basic rule; 0.762 with col1/col2 height suppression; 0.842 adding ply decay for the row-3 case (sim share 1.05). Row 5 inconsistent. Misses are col0 stacks reached a few plies earlier. Synthesis tops ~4.7, below dev max 5.04.
